label: UCS C220 M6 1U rack server
description: 1U two-socket UCS rack server with two motherboard LAN ports that run 1GbE or 10GbE depending on the link partner, plus a 1GbE dedicated CIMC management port. A modular LOM (mLOM) bay accepts a VIC without using a PCIe slot.
notes: Onboard: 2x RJ45 LAN1/LAN2 rated 1G/10G (10GBASE-T copper) - the port speed follows the link partner, so a 1G switch yields 1G. 3x PCIe 4.0 slots plus the mLOM bay for a VIC 1440/1480 (10/25/40/100GbE). CIMC 1GbE port is dedicated out-of-band.
